statement: xwiimote consumes the Linux driver's core, extension and MotionPlus evdev nodes, not raw Wii register responses. For Plus with external MP or nested MPs it inherits whichever one gyro node the kernel exposes; it cannot independently identify the downstream second MP or expose two distinct sensor sources through its reviewed API.
